test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains M and N cross a pole in 30 seconds and 1 minute 45 seconds, respectively. The length of train M is half the length of train N. The respective ratio of the speed of train M to that of train N is:
solution:
Given:

Train M crosses a pole in 30 seconds.

Train N crosses a platform in 1 minute 45 seconds

Formula used:

Speed = Distance/Time

Calculation:

M = 0.5N (Given)

Speed of M = 0.5N/30

Speed of N = N/105

The ratio of their speed = 105:60 = 7:4

**The answer is 7:4.**
